_readme: Fixed question set for nyc-checkbook-mcp, written 2026-11-18 before scoring (#55). Each question is one a person has asked or would ask, and each has a known right answer.

Offline: every question runs against a recorded reply (`fixture`, a file under test/fixtures/, most of them real Checkbook NYC replies with provenance in the file) or a generated success reply (`reply`: count and rows). Nothing reaches the network.

The right answer is what this server must do with that reply: which request it sends (or that it sends none), and what it tells the person. The data in the replies is not re-checked here; the tests and scripts/check-default-columns.mjs cover the API side.

Checks: `requests` (exact number sent), `sent_includes` / `sent_excludes` (text in the request XML), `is_error`, `text` (regexes the answer must match), `field` ([dotted path, value] pairs in the answer's JSON).
Run: npm run eval (writes eval/runs/YYYY-MM-DD.json). Every check must pass; a failing question is a bug or a wrong expectation, never a skip.

questions.q: How many budget lines does the Parks Department have in FY2026, and what is the first one's adopted amount?

text: Showing records 1 to 2 of 12,397\. For the next 2, call again with page=2

questions.note: The Budget domain's year criterion is `year`, not `fiscal_year` (verified live 2026-07-06). Amounts stay strings, nested as the API sends them. Path corrected after the first run (eval/runs/2026-11-18-first-run.txt): it was records.0.adopted; the value is unchanged.

questions.q: What contracts does Acme Consulting hold with the city?

text: no vendor-name filter|filters vendors only by 'vendor_code'

questions.note: No vendor-name parameter exists; the server must say so and point to search_spending, not return unrelated contracts (#17, #19).

questions.q: What contracts did the city sign with vendor 'Acme' (using the parameter name a model guesses)?
questions.note: #19: an invented `vendor` key once returned 5,755,099 unrelated rows.

questions.q: Which registered revenue contracts were active in FY2025?

text: Omit fiscal_year and filter by date range

questions.note: #42: the API counts matches for this shape and returns no rows.

text: matched 12293 Contracts record\(s\) but returned none
Do not conclude that no records exist

questions.note: Real reply 2026-10-16: 12,293 matched, no rows. It must never read as an empty result.

text: Showing the first 1 of 12293 records for this contract

questions.note: Revenue contracts use plain column names (#42). The fixture is a real reply whose count covers the whole revenue set, so the count line must say more exist.

questions.q: What did the NYPD spend in FY2025?

field: Office of the New York City Comptroller
text: For the next 50, call again with page=2
BetaNYC modified this data: .*Official record: .*Office of the New York City Comptroller.*, https://www\.checkbooknyc\.com/data-feeds/api

questions.note: 056 is NYPD; 040 is Education (#37). The count is the FY2025 Spending total recorded in #32.

questions.q: How much did the city pay in overtime to Parks staff in calendar year 2025?
questions.note: A real zero is a success with total_records 0 and says so, not an error (#21).

questions.q: What are the payroll records for Parks with no year given?

text: Either fiscal_year or calendar_year is required

questions.note: The API needs a year; the server refuses before spending a request.
